description: This file defines a Java interface `SalesManagerEntityService`, which provides generic service methods for managing entities in a sales management system, including CRUD operations, list retrieval, and session management.

classes.name: SalesManagerEntityService
classes.description: A generic interface for entity management services, supporting create, read, update, delete, refresh, list, count, and session management operations.

methods.name: save
methods.description: Saves a new entity into the database.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing entity in the database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Creates a new entity in the database (potentially with different semantics from save).

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes the specified entity from the database.

methods.name: refresh
methods.description: Reloads the entity's state from the database.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by its identifier.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Returns a list of all entities of this type.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Retrieves an entity by class type and identifier.

methods.name: count
methods.description: Returns the total number of entities of this type.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the current session to persist changes.
